_readme: PoC-15 complexity-tier fixtures. 48 hand-labeled personal-assistant messages. These represent inputs that ALREADY fell through deterministic matching (no slash commands, no fast-path regex hits). Fields: id, tier (primary ground-truth label), accept (array of acceptable labels; length 2 => deliberately ambiguous), trap_class (none|long_cheap|short_deep), chars, notes.

_tiers.cheap: conversational reply, acknowledgment, simple lookup, or one-step action a small model handles fine
_tiers.standard: routine multi-step work needing competence but not depth
_tiers.deep: genuine reasoning or stakes: multi-constraint planning, consequential decisions, hard analysis

fixtures.notes: one-step reminder

fixtures.notes: bare confirmation

fixtures.notes: one-step recurring reminder, slightly longer phrasing

fixtures.text: what time does the hardware store on eighth close on sundays
fixtures.notes: single lookup

fixtures.text: put the dentist on the calendar for march 4th at 2, thirty minutes should be fine
fixtures.notes: one-step calendar add with a trivial parameter

fixtures.text: whats the wifi password again, the garage one not the house one
fixtures.notes: single retrieval with a disambiguator

fixtures.text: whats on my plate today
fixtures.notes: AMBIGUOUS: a calendar+task readout is cheap; a real triage of the day is standard

fixtures.text: ok so today was kind of a disaster. the plumber showed up almost two hours late and then told me he needed a part he didnt have on the truck, so hes coming back thursday, and while he was under the sink he noticed the water heater is basically ancient and will probably need replacing inside a year, which i genuinely do not want to think about right now. and then while i was dealing with all of that the dog got into the trash again and there was chicken bones everywhere. anyway. can you add plumber thursday to my calendar
fixtures.notes: TRAP long_cheap: 500+ chars of venting, actual ask is a one-step calendar add

fixtures.text: i was on the phone with my mom for like an hour and a half tonight and she was doing the thing again where she brings up the cabin and how nobody really uses it anymore and how she and dad arent getting any younger, which i am fairly sure is her way of asking whether we would want it eventually. i dont have an answer for that and im not going to try to work it out tonight. she did say her birthday dinner is on the 14th this year, not the 15th like i had it down. can you just fix that on my calendar
fixtures.notes: TRAP long_cheap: emotionally weighty rambling with an explicitly deferred hard question; the actual ask is a date correction

fixtures.text: that meeting ran forty minutes over for absolutely no reason, half of it was two people relitigating a decision we already made in april, and i could not get a word in about the thing i actually joined for. i have no idea how we keep doing this to ourselves. completely unrelated but i need to call the vet before they close, do you have their number
fixtures.notes: TRAP long_cheap: 350 chars of frustration, ask is a phone number lookup

fixtures.text: i have been telling myself for three weeks that i am going to get back to the gym and it keeps not happening, mostly because mornings are a mess right now and by evening im cooked. i think the honest answer is i need to stop pretending im a morning person and just go at lunch, which the office schedule actually kind of allows if i move one standing thing. whatever, ill figure it out. add protein powder to the shopping list
fixtures.notes: TRAP long_cheap: self-reflection that resolves itself, ask is a list append

fixtures.text: the conference thing is turning into a whole production, they moved my session to the last slot on the last day which basically guarantees nobody will be there, and now the organizers are asking if i can also sit on a panel wednesday morning which i said maybe to which was probably a mistake given i already said yes to the dinner. i regret all of it. what time is my flight on the 12th
fixtures.notes: TRAP long_cheap: overcommitment venting, ask is a single flight-time lookup

fixtures.text: the neighbours put in a fence right along the property line and did not say a word to us about it beforehand, which is not illegal as far as i know but is a choice. it is also about four inches onto our side by my read of the survey, and i am trying to decide whether that is worth being the guy who brings up a survey with people i have to live next to for the next decade. leaning no. anyway remind me to put the bins out sunday night
fixtures.notes: TRAP long_cheap: a real dilemma the user explicitly resolves themselves, ask is a reminder

fixtures.text: draft a reply to the landlord about the deposit, firm but not hostile
fixtures.notes: routine drafting with tone constraint

fixtures.text: summarize what actually happened with the kitchen project this month
fixtures.notes: multi-source summarization

fixtures.text: plan tomorrow around my 3 meetings
fixtures.notes: short but routine multi-step scheduling

fixtures.text: put together a packing list for portland, four days, one nice dinner, probably rain
fixtures.notes: routine generation with a few constraints

fixtures.text: go through this weeks email and tell me what actually needs a response from me
fixtures.notes: triage across many items, competence not depth

fixtures.text: take my notes from the school meeting and turn them into something i can send to the other parents without embarrassing myself
fixtures.notes: cleanup and rewrite for an audience

fixtures.text: compare the two rental car options i saved and just tell me which one to book
fixtures.notes: AMBIGUOUS: two-option comparison is arguably a lookup-and-pick (cheap) or a real small analysis (standard)

fixtures.text: find me a dentist near the office that takes our insurance and has evening appointments
fixtures.notes: multi-constraint search, low stakes

fixtures.text: make the grocery list for the week off the meals we said we were doing, and skip anything we already have
fixtures.notes: routine multi-step with a filter

fixtures.text: my notes on the garage rebuild are all over the place, turn them into an actual sequenced todo list
fixtures.notes: restructuring, ordering matters but stakes are low

fixtures.text: this week got away from me. i had the dentist monday which i moved, the two site visits got stacked onto wednesday which is also the day of the school thing at 4, and i still owe sam the review notes i promised last friday. thursday is currently empty which feels suspicious. can you reshuffle what is movable so wednesday is not insane and i actually have a block to do the review notes before friday
fixtures.notes: long, genuinely multi-step rescheduling but no real stakes or judgment call

fixtures.text: draft a thank you note to the team, warm but not corny, mention the launch specifically and name check priya and dev
fixtures.notes: drafting with constraints

fixtures.text: what did i say i would do over the last two weeks that i havent actually done
fixtures.notes: retrieval plus reconciliation across sources

fixtures.text: book 45 minutes with sam next week, mornings are better for me, and send him the agenda from the doc when you do
fixtures.notes: multi-step action chain, mechanical

fixtures.text: the utility company sent this: your account has been assessed a late fee of 45 dollars for the billing period ending june 30, plus a reconnection charge of 60 dollars. our records indicate no payment was received. please remit the balance of 312.40 within 14 days to avoid further action. i paid that on the 28th, i have the confirmation. write me a reply that is polite but makes it very clear this is their error and asks them to reverse both charges
fixtures.notes: long, contains a quoted document, but the work is routine correspondence

fixtures.text: help me figure out what to say to my sister about christmas
fixtures.notes: AMBIGUOUS: could be a quick message draft (standard) or genuine relational reasoning (deep)

fixtures.text: should i sell the house?
fixtures.notes: TRAP short_deep: 24 chars, enormous stakes

fixtures.text: is this mole worrying
fixtures.notes: TRAP short_deep: health, high stakes, minimal text

fixtures.text: help me think through whether to take the job offer given the equity and the commute
fixtures.notes: consequential decision with competing factors

fixtures.text: restructure the drey launch plan given the vendor slipped three weeks
fixtures.notes: multi-constraint replanning with downstream consequences

fixtures.text: review this clause for risk: the contractor may substitute materials of comparable quality at its sole discretion without notice to the owner, and any dispute as to comparability shall be resolved by the contractor acting reasonably. also tell me what to ask for instead
fixtures.notes: legal analysis, real downside if done badly

fixtures.text: two bids on the roof. one is 22k, licensed, bonded, ten year workmanship warranty, cannot start until late october which puts us into the rain. the other is 16k, has done three houses on our street and they all look fine, warranty is basically a handshake, could start next week. we are probably in this house another four years, maybe more if my job goes the way i think it will. help me decide
fixtures.notes: multi-constraint tradeoff under uncertainty

fixtures.text: one of my reports has missed three deadlines in six weeks and the last one hurt a client. i also know from a conversation in may that her mother is very ill and she has been the one handling it. i need to address the performance without pretending the context does not exist, and i have a skip level with my own boss on friday where this will come up. how do i handle both
fixtures.notes: high-stakes people decision with competing obligations

fixtures.text: the inspection came back with settlement cracking on the north foundation wall, the engineer says it is probably historic but recommends monitoring, and the seller is refusing to budge on price. walk away or negotiate, and if negotiate, on what
fixtures.notes: consequential financial decision with technical uncertainty

fixtures.text: churn jumped from 4 to 7 percent last quarter and nobody has a convincing story for why. the obvious candidates are the pricing change in april, the onboarding rewrite that shipped in may, and the fact that we lost two of the three people who did customer calls. figure out what the data would have to look like for each of those to be the real cause, tell me which is most likely, and what i should do about it before the board call
fixtures.notes: genuine causal analysis with a decision attached

fixtures.text: i have to decide by friday whether to sign the lease renewal at 14 percent higher or move. moving costs us roughly six weeks of disruption and i do not know what the market looks like in the spring. what would you want to know before deciding, and what is your read
fixtures.notes: deadline-forced decision under uncertainty

fixtures.text: my parents are 78 and 81 and still in the house they have been in for forty years, which has stairs and is three hours from us. dad had a fall in january that was fine and one in june that was not really fine. neither of them wants to move and my brother thinks i am catastrophizing. i need to work out what the actual options are, what the trigger would be for each one, and how i raise this with them without it becoming a fight
fixtures.notes: high-stakes family planning with multiple constraints

fixtures.text: should i push the launch a week
fixtures.notes: AMBIGUOUS: could be a quick scheduling call (standard) or a real judgment with downstream consequences (deep)
